nom: Solawave Bye Acne: 3-Minute Blue + Red Light Therapy Acne Treatment

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports the device speeds healing of pre-period breakouts and fades acne scars.

concerns.spots: Reports are mixed: one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin says it helps breakouts heal faster and fades scars, and another saw small bumps surface and resolve with reduced redness; two other reviewers say their acne looked the same or worse despite consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer describes bumps coming to the surface and clearing within days, while another reports her acne looked worse after consistent use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the device brought down redness and a bump after five days of use.

aspects.libelle: Requires holding still 3 minutes per spot
Temporary dark marks from increased circulation

extraits.texte: It does nothing, you have to hold still for 3 minutes over 1 spot and then you have to charge it again. This being almost $100 is highway robbery. Just another piece of junk in the trash

I had really high hopes for this product but unfortunately my face looks worse than before as far as acne and ive used it consistently as described. Also its just hard to sit there with your arm holding it up for 3 mins per spot.

I have oily, acne prone skin. I always get a few breakouts before my period. They usually take a few weeks to fully heal. This device helps tremendously with healing and to fade acne scars quickly! Wish I found this years ago!
I used it over the 5 days and saw improvement! Brought down redness and bump.

I love this and think it worked really well! I got it on sale for a lot less so wasnt expecting a ton but i saw results after the second use. Some small bumps on my cheek that had formed came to the surface by the second day. On my other cheek i used it and right after i took it off i saw these dark spots in the formation of the light. Thought i burned myself or something but it turned out it was the increased circulation! Went away after ab a minute and my skin looked great. It can feel like it takes a while when you have to hold it in place for 3 min but i just do it after washing my face while i watch tv and it isn't bad at all. Plus it counts down for you and automatically shuts off. I do not have lots of acne to be fair but I don't think this product is for if you have bad acne as it says mild to moderate acne on it. I got it for early breakouts, breakout prevention, and dark spots. I have to see the long term effects for me but so far I would recommend this

reserve: Only 7 reviews are available and just one specifies a skin type, so conclusions by skin type are very limited.
